<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_DIYPhoneRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/diy-phone-repair">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ItemRequest" name="Request item from friend"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PhoneToExpert" name="Send phone to expert"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_DIYRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="DIY Customer" processRef="Process_DIYRepair"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friend" name="Friend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Repair Expert"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestItem" name="Borrow or buy request"
                      sourceRef="Task_ContactFriend" targetRef="Participant_Friend"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneToExpert" name="Phone sent to expert"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_DIYRepair" name="DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Repair">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Repair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterModel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckOwned</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FriendSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ContactFriend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FriendMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuyRest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Repair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Success</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Output</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UploadVideo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OutputJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Completed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendExpert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Expert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RepairTool" name="Online Repair Tool">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Lists</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Instructions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Repair" name="Repair started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterModel" name="Enter phone model and broken part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Lists" name="Provide material list, tool list and ordering choices">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckOwned" name="Identify items already owned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendSplit" name="Friend can lend or sell cheaply?" default="Flow_FriendDefault">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendDefault</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriend" name="Contact friend to borrow or buy item" messageRef="Msg_ItemRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendMerge" name="Friend option resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendDefault</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BuyRest" name="Buy remaining materials and tools">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Instructions" name="Provide repair instructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Repair" name="Repair screen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Success" name="Repair successful?" default="Flow_NotWorked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Worked</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotWorked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Output" name="Send review and/or video">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Worked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VideoChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitReview" name="Send review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UploadVideo" name="Send video of repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VideoChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VideoDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OutputJoin" name="Output sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VideoDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Completed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Repair completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Completed</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendExpert" name="Send phone to expert" messageRef="Msg_PhoneToExpert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotWorked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExpertDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Expert" name="Phone sent to expert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExpertDone</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterModel" targetRef="Task_Lists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Lists" targetRef="Task_CheckOwned"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_CheckOwned" targetRef="Gateway_FriendSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendSplit" targetRef="Task_ContactFriend">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${friendAvailable == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendDefault" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendSplit" targetRef="Gateway_FriendMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendDone" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriend" targetRef="Gateway_FriendMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendMerge" targetRef="Task_BuyRest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_BuyRest" targetRef="Task_Instructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Instructions" targetRef="Task_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="Gateway_Success"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Worked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Success" targetRef="Gateway_Output">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairSuccessful == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotWorked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Success" targetRef="Task_SendExpert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewChosen" sourceRef="Gateway_Output" targetRef="Task_SubmitReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendReview == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VideoChosen" sourceRef="Gateway_Output" targetRef="Task_UploadVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendVideo == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewDone" sourceRef="Task_SubmitReview" targetRef="Gateway_OutputJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VideoDone" sourceRef="Task_UploadVideo" targetRef="Gateway_OutputJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Completed" sourceRef="Gateway_OutputJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpertDone" sourceRef="Task_SendExpert" targetRef="EndEvent_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterModel" name="Enter phone model and broken part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnteredToListSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ListSplit" name="Lists requested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnteredToListSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToListMaterials</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToListTools</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToListOrderingChoices</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ListMaterials" name="List materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToListMaterials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MaterialsToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ListTools" name="List tools">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToListTools</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToolsToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ListOrderingChoices" name="List ordering choices for each part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToListOrderingChoices</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderingToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ListJoin" name="Lists provided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MaterialsToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToolsToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderingToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ListsToCheckOwned</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckOwned" name="Identify items already owned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ListsToCheckOwned</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OwnedToFriend</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendSplit" name="Friend can lend or sell cheaply?" default="Flow_FriendDefault">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OwnedToFriend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendDefault</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriend" name="Contact friend to borrow or buy item" messageRef="Msg_ItemRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendMerge" name="Friend option resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendDefault</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendResolved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BuyRest" name="Buy remaining materials and tools">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendResolved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bought</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Instructions" name="Instruct how to fix phone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bought</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Instructed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Repair" name="Repair screen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Instructed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repaired</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Success" name="Repair successful?" default="Flow_NotWorked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repaired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Worked</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotWorked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Output" name="Send review and/or video">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Worked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VideoChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitReview" name="Send review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UploadVideo" name="Send video of repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VideoChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VideoDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OutputJoin" name="Output sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VideoDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Completed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Repair completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Completed</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendExpert" name="Send phone to expert" messageRef="Msg_PhoneToExpert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotWorked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExpertDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Expert" name="Phone sent to expert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExpertDone</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnteredToListSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterModel" targetRef="Gateway_ListSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToListMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_ListSplit" targetRef="Task_ListMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToListTools" sourceRef="Gateway_ListSplit" targetRef="Task_ListTools"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToListOrderingChoices" sourceRef="Gateway_ListSplit" targetRef="Task_ListOrderingChoices"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MaterialsToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ListMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ListJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolsToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ListTools" targetRef="Gateway_ListJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderingToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ListOrderingChoices" targetRef="Gateway_ListJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListsToCheckOwned" sourceRef="Gateway_ListJoin" targetRef="Task_CheckOwned"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OwnedToFriend" sourceRef="Task_CheckOwned" targetRef="Gateway_FriendSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendSplit" targetRef="Task_ContactFriend">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${friendAvailable == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendDefault" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendSplit" targetRef="Gateway_FriendMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendDone" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriend" targetRef="Gateway_FriendMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendResolved" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendMerge" targetRef="Task_BuyRest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bought" sourceRef="Task_BuyRest" targetRef="Task_Instructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Instructed" sourceRef="Task_Instructions" targetRef="Task_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repaired" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="Gateway_Success"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Worked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Success" targetRef="Gateway_Output">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairSuccessful == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotWorked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Success" targetRef="Task_SendExpert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewChosen" sourceRef="Gateway_Output" targetRef="Task_SubmitReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendReview == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VideoChosen" sourceRef="Gateway_Output" targetRef="Task_UploadVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendVideo == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewDone" sourceRef="Task_SubmitReview" targetRef="Gateway_OutputJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VideoDone" sourceRef="Task_UploadVideo" targetRef="Gateway_OutputJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Completed" sourceRef="Gateway_OutputJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpertDone" sourceRef="Task_SendExpert" targetRef="EndEvent_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_DIYPhoneRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/diy-phone-repair">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ItemRequest" name="Request item from friend"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PhoneToExpert" name="Send phone to expert"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_DIYRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="DIY Customer" processRef="Process_DIYRepair"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friend" name="Friend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Repair Expert"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestItem" name="Borrow or buy request"
                      sourceRef="Task_ContactFriend" targetRef="Participant_Friend"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneToExpert" name="Phone sent to expert"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_DIYRepair" name="DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Repair">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Repair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterModel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterBrokenPart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ListSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ListJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckOwned</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DecideFriend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FriendSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ContactFriend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FriendMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuyRest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Repair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Success</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Output</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UploadVideo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OutputJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Completed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendExpert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Expert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RepairTool" name="Online Repair Tool">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ListMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ListTools</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ListOrderingChoices</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Instructions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Repair" name="Smartphone screen broken">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterModel" name="Enter phone model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ModelToBrokenPart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBrokenPart" name="Enter broken part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ModelToBrokenPart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BrokenPartToListSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ListSplit" name="Lists requested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BrokenPartToListSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToListMaterials</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToListTools</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToListOrderingChoices</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ListMaterials" name="List materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToListMaterials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MaterialsToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ListTools" name="List tools">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToListTools</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToolsToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ListOrderingChoices" name="List ordering choices for each part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToListOrderingChoices</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderingToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ListJoin" name="Lists provided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MaterialsToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToolsToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderingToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ListsToCheckOwned</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckOwned" name="Identify items already owned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ListsToCheckOwned</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OwnedToDecideFriend</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideFriend" name="Decide whether to contact a friend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OwnedToDecideFriend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecideToFriendSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendSplit" name="Contact a friend?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecideToFriendSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriend" name="Contact friend to borrow or buy item" messageRef="Msg_ItemRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendMerge" name="Friend option resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendResolved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BuyRest" name="Buy remaining materials and tools">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendResolved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bought</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Instructions" name="Instruct how to fix phone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bought</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Instructed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Repair" name="Repair screen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Instructed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repaired</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Success" name="Is the repair successful?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repaired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Worked</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotWorked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Output" name="Send review and/or video">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Worked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VideoChosen</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitReview" name="Send review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UploadVideo" name="Send video of repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VideoChosen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VideoDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OutputJoin" name="Output sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VideoDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Completed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Repair completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Completed</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendExpert" name="Send phone to expert" messageRef="Msg_PhoneToExpert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotWorked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExpertDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Expert" name="Phone sent to expert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExpertDone</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ModelToBrokenPart" sourceRef="Task_EnterModel" targetRef="Task_EnterBrokenPart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BrokenPartToListSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterBrokenPart" targetRef="Gateway_ListSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToListMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_ListSplit" targetRef="Task_ListMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToListTools" sourceRef="Gateway_ListSplit" targetRef="Task_ListTools"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToListOrderingChoices" sourceRef="Gateway_ListSplit" targetRef="Task_ListOrderingChoices"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MaterialsToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ListMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ListJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolsToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ListTools" targetRef="Gateway_ListJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderingToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ListOrderingChoices" targetRef="Gateway_ListJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListsToCheckOwned" sourceRef="Gateway_ListJoin" targetRef="Task_CheckOwned"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OwnedToDecideFriend" sourceRef="Task_CheckOwned" targetRef="Task_DecideFriend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecideToFriendSplit" sourceRef="Task_DecideFriend" targetRef="Gateway_FriendSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendSplit" targetRef="Task_ContactFriend">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${contactFriend == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendSplit" targetRef="Gateway_FriendMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${contactFriend == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendDone" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriend" targetRef="Gateway_FriendMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendResolved" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendMerge" targetRef="Task_BuyRest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bought" sourceRef="Task_BuyRest" targetRef="Task_Instructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Instructed" sourceRef="Task_Instructions" targetRef="Task_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repaired" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="Gateway_Success"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Worked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Success" targetRef="Gateway_Output">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairSuccessful == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotWorked" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Success" targetRef="Task_SendExpert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairSuccessful == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewChosen" sourceRef="Gateway_Output" targetRef="Task_SubmitReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendReview == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VideoChosen" sourceRef="Gateway_Output" targetRef="Task_UploadVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendVideo == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewDone" sourceRef="Task_SubmitReview" targetRef="Gateway_OutputJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VideoDone" sourceRef="Task_UploadVideo" targetRef="Gateway_OutputJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Completed" sourceRef="Gateway_OutputJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpertDone" sourceRef="Task_SendExpert" targetRef="EndEvent_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
